name: The American University of Paris
summary: Small American-style liberal-arts university in central Paris, all in English; 25 majors, discussion-based classes and IB scholarships.

ib.text: The IB Diploma waives the English test. Automatic scholarships by final score: 32–35 €7,000 a year up to full tuition at 44–45; 30+ points earn a year of credit.

apply.via: AUP Application Portal or the Common Application

noDeadline: Applications accepted year round; late admission after 1 April

dates.label: Regular Admission round; late admission follows after 1 April

notes: Official IB results must reach the Admissions Office before the first day of classes.
Tuition was €38,080 for 2026–27, plus health fees and a one-time €900 campus development fee.
SAT and ACT are optional; you send two recommendations and a 650-word statement plus a 300-word AUP essay.
